name: Bevacizumab single-agent

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Central Nervous System Cancers (general reference)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: None routine
premedications.notes: no standard chemotherapy premedication; verify blood pressure and urine protein before each infusion.

supportiveCare: Helps corticosteroid-refractory edema and mass-effect symptoms; can allow steroid tapering.
Hold around surgery (about 4 weeks before and after) for wound-healing and to reduce bleeding risk.
Counsel on hypertension, proteinuria, bleeding, thromboembolism, and the rare bowel-perforation risk.
monitoring: Blood pressure at each visit; treat hypertension
Urine protein (dipstick, then protein/creatinine ratio if positive)
MRI response assessment every 2-3 cycles - interpret with care because bevacizumab reduces enhancement

drugs.name: Bevacizumab
drugs.notes: 10 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks (day 1 of a 14-day cycle) until progression or unacceptable toxicity; an equivalent 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks schedule is sometimes used. Anti-VEGF option at recurrent glioblastoma for symptom/edema control (NCCN CNS / DeVita, general reference; own wording).
